from cobol_equiv.runtime import (
    Storage, Group, Num, Alnum, Stdin, move, add, subtract_giving,
    multiply_giving, divide_giving, display_bytes, display_line, SPACES,
)


def main(stdin: bytes, input_files: dict[str, bytes]) -> tuple[bytes, dict[str, bytes]]:
    ws = Storage("WS", [
        Group("WS-COMPLEX-CONSTANT", [
            Num("C-REAL", "S9V999"),
            Num("C-IMAGINARY", "S9V999"),
        ]),
        Group("WS-ARGAND-PLANE", [
            Num("X", "S9(9)V999"),
            Num("Y", "S9(9)V999"),
        ]),
        Group("WS-COMPLEX-VARIABLE", [
            Num("Z-REAL", "S9(9)V999"),
            Num("Z-IMAGINARY", "S9(9)V999"),
        ]),
        Group("WS-TEMPORARY-RESULTS", [
            Num("X-SQUARED", "S9(9)V999"),
            Num("Y-SQUARED", "S9(9)V999"),
            Num("X-TIMES-Y", "S9(9)V999"),
            Num("Z-REAL-SQUARED", "S9(9)V999"),
        ]),
        Group("WS-LOOP-COUNTERS", [
            Num("HORIZONTAL", "999"),
            Num("VERTICAL", "999"),
            Num("ITERATIONS", "99"),
        ]),
        Alnum("WS-PLOT-CHARACTER", "X"),
    ])
    out = bytearray()
    inp = Stdin(stdin)

    c_real = ws["C-REAL"]
    c_imag = ws["C-IMAGINARY"]
    x = ws["X"]
    y = ws["Y"]
    zr = ws["Z-REAL"]
    zi = ws["Z-IMAGINARY"]
    xsq = ws["X-SQUARED"]
    ysq = ws["Y-SQUARED"]
    xty = ws["X-TIMES-Y"]
    zrsq = ws["Z-REAL-SQUARED"]
    horiz = ws["HORIZONTAL"]
    vert = ws["VERTICAL"]
    iters = ws["ITERATIONS"]
    plot = ws["WS-PLOT-CHARACTER"]

    inp.accept(c_real)
    inp.accept(c_imag)

    def complex_mult():
        multiply_giving(x, x, xsq)
        multiply_giving(y, y, ysq)
        subtract_giving(ysq, xsq, zr)
        add(c_real, zr)
        multiply_giving(x, y, xty)
        multiply_giving(xty, 2, zi)
        add(c_imag, zi)
        multiply_giving(zr, zr, zrsq)
        if zrsq.value > 10000:
            move(SPACES, plot)
        move(zr, x)
        move(zi, y)

    def computation():
        subtract_giving(280, horiz, x)
        subtract_giving(160, vert, y)
        divide_giving(x, 200, x)
        divide_giving(y, 100, y)
        move("#", plot)
        move(1, iters)
        while not (int(iters) > 50 or plot.raw == b" "):
            complex_mult()
            add(1, iters)
        out.extend(display_bytes(plot))

    def outer():
        move(1, horiz)
        while not (int(horiz) > 560):
            computation()
            add(10, horiz)
        out.extend(display_line(" "))

    move(1, vert)
    while not (int(vert) > 320):
        outer()
        add(10, vert)

    return bytes(out), {}
